sector: A B2B distributor of OEM elevator & electrical replacement components, sold to service technicians, maintenance supervisors and electrical contractors.
founded_place_size: Cleveland, Ohio; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: Girdermark Components is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Cleveland, Ohio, and this commission covers phase 2: data-sheet and bin-label library.
audience: Working buyers aged thirty five to sixty who have specified this class of part for twenty years and judge a supplier by whether the picture and the numbers match.
price_positioning: Parts from 400 to 9,000 dollars. A flat, even, technical register: one neutral photographic ground, the whole part in frame, generous spec setting, prices plain in the run of the page. Never bright consumer tool styling and never dark cinematic hero work. The bin label answers to a picker at arm's length, so it is bigger, blunter and carries less.

palette.name: Girder Blue
palette.usage: Only the 2 pt rule locked directly beneath each part number at the part number's own measure, as the type system sets it and label_2026_PRESS.pdf prints it. Never type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Signal Amber
palette.usage: Neither press PDF uses it. At most a small marker or a short rule, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area. Never type, a ground, a panel, or a flash or highlight on a price.

palette.name: Steel Grey
palette.usage: Spec field labels and small panel titles, hairline dividers, the footer rule, the keyline around the part photograph and the certification-strip keyline, as sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf prints them, and the picture keyline, as label_2026_PRESS.pdf prints it. Never a ground, panel, part number, spec value or price.

palette.name: Warehouse White
palette.usage: The only designed, non-photographic ground and panel colour of every data sheet and bin label, as sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf and label_2026_PRESS.pdf print it; the ground the house mark sits on. Never a type colour.

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.usage: The house mark in one ink, the part number, description, spec values, ordering code, prices and footer line; on the sheet the two full-width header rules and the mark and ordering-panel keylines, as sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf prints them; on the label the mark keyline, as label_2026_PRESS.pdf prints it. Never a ground or panel.

typography: Girdermark Components sets Saira Condensed Black over IBM Plex Sans Regular. Step 01, the part number, is Saira Condensed Black at 30 pt on 33 pt on the sheet and 36 pt on 40 pt on the bin label, optically tracked to fill the exact panel measure edge to edge with a 2 pt Girder Blue rule locked beneath at that same measure, and 96 px on screen. Step 02, the sheet header, is Saira Condensed Black at 18 pt on 20 pt tracked 0.02 em, a size supplied here because the prose names the role but no number. Step 03, the spec row, is IBM Plex Sans Regular at 9 pt on 12 pt, tracking 0, tabular figures on, a maximum of 65 characters a line, with prices in the same face at 14 pt sitting plain in the run of the page. Step 04, the revision and source line, is IBM Plex Sans Regular at 7 pt on 10 pt tracked 0.03 em, again a supplied size. Nothing is ever italicised.
voice: Blunt, factual and useful. No marketing adjectives, no styling in the words. Example line the brand would write: "Sixteen active parts this season. Specs, codes and prices are exactly as our system holds them."
brand_assets_status: The division owns none of its own artwork. The spec sheet and the bin label exist only as the flat press PDFs the printer and the label house return. The house mark was lost in an office move and survives only in the printed sheet header and cast into an aluminium nameplate riveted to an old traction machine in the back, photographed for reference. Part photography was shot in house on the bench over several months and does not match.
values: Accuracy above all: the picture and the spec must agree, values are never reworded to fit, and anything that will not fit is raised before it prints.

type_system.signature_move: The part number is optically tracked to fill the exact measure of its panel, edge to edge, with a 2 pt Girder Blue rule locked directly beneath it at that same measure, so a viewer sees first a condensed black code underscored corner to corner. That behaviour governs step 01 at every size: 30 pt on the sheet, 36 pt on the bin label, 96 px on screen.
rules: The part number is optically tracked to the exact panel measure, edge to edge, with a 2 pt Girder Blue rule beneath it at the same measure.
Saira Condensed Black sets every part number, sheet header and bin label line.
The bin label sets the part number at 36 pt and screen sets it at 96 px.
IBM Plex Sans Regular sets spec rows at 9 pt on 12 pt with tabular figures on, and prices at 14 pt.
Prices sit plain in the run of the page, never bright consumer tool styling and never dark cinematic hero work.
The picture and the spec must agree; values are never reworded to fit, and anything that will not fit is raised before it prints.
The bin label answers to a picker at arm's length, so it is bigger, blunter and carries less than the sheet.

palette_rules.distribution: Warehouse White is the only designed, non-photographic ground and panel colour on every sheet and label, as on sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf and label_2026_PRESS.pdf. On it, the house mark, part number, description, spec values, ordering code, prices and footer line are Ink Black; spec field labels and small panel titles may be Steel Grey, as on sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf. On the sheet the two full-width header rules and the mark and ordering-panel keylines are Ink Black; hairline dividers, the footer rule, the photograph keyline and the certification-strip keyline are Steel Grey, as on sheet_2026_PRESS.pdf. On the label the mark keyline is Ink Black and the picture keyline Steel Grey, as on label_2026_PRESS.pdf. The 2 pt rule beneath every part number is Girder Blue. Signal Amber is an optional small accent, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, and never type, a ground or a panel.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, as both press PDFs print them. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, keylines, markers or icons. No dark ground or panel, since the brand never does dark cinematic hero work; no badge, burst, colour flash or highlight panel on a price, since it never does bright consumer tool styling; no gradient, glow, gloss or metallic effect. Girder Blue and Signal Amber never set type.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep each part's own true colour and finish and are never tinted or duotoned toward the palette. Every part sits whole in frame on one neutral photographic ground, the same on every sheet and label.
